title: Domain XLAM panel product catalog

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root public exports for the migrated XLAM panel catalog functions

sourceOracles.coverage: XLAM panel catalog registration, retrieval and listing; downstream out-of-plane application coverage remains outside this slice

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript XLAM catalog modules, including exact JSON, cloning, Unicode and error-path comparisons.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for default, registered, listed and cloned products
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for layer thickness and active-layer values
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source module-level generic product, registration keys, shallow product cloning, layer-thickness and metadata copies, listing order and missing-id errors.
XLAM panel sections, materials, beam or panel applications and engineering verification formulas remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic XLAM panel product catalog storage and cloning only; no panel section, material catalog or out-of-plane verification implementation is introduced.
